title: BentoPDF
name: bentopdf
description: PDF toolkit that runs in your browser, so files never leave your machine. Merge, split, compress, convert, sign and edit. Source: https://github.com/alam00000/bentopdf
note: Open http://<your-host>:8090. There's no login and nothing to back up, since every PDF is processed in your browser rather than on the server. Converting Word, Excel or PowerPoint files needs it served over HTTPS though (or opened as localhost on the same machine), as browsers block the bit it relies on over plain http. Docs: github.com/alam00000/bentopdf
